name: Hashabneiah
overview: Hashabneiah is a male biblical figure known primarily as the father of Hattush. There is no record of his tribal affiliation or additional personal details beyond his paternal role. His mention is brief and specific within the biblical text.
namesAndTitles: The name Hashabneiah likely means 'YHWH has considered me,' indicating a theophoric element that reflects God's involvement or care. This meaning is derived from the Hebrew components of the name as noted in Nehemiah 3:10.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Hashabneiah as the father of Hattush, establishing a direct paternal relationship. Beyond this, there are no other family connections or relationships noted for him.
scriptureSignificance: Hashabneiah's significance lies in his identification as the father of Hattush, who is mentioned in the context of the rebuilding efforts in Jerusalem. Though a minor figure, his mention preserves the lineage and community involvement during this period. His name's meaning also subtly points to the providence of God in the lives of those involved in the restoration.
